free_tier.stated: free hosted forward and reverse DNS with multiple domains per account, in open beta, for IPv6 certification or tunnelbroker account holders, colocation customers and transit customers

retention.stated: zones persist while the account is active

interface_detail: no record-management API is documented on dns.he.net or dns.he.net/docs.html; the programmatic path is the dyndns-compatible endpoint https://dyn.dns.he.net/nic/update?hostname=<record>&password=<key>&myip=<address> (GET, POST, or HTTP basic auth with the record name as the user), one request for IPv4 and one for IPv6, and txt= in place of myip= for a TXT record first created in the panel; the dynamic service is included free with a dns.he.net account
tooling: the web panel for zone and record management; the dyndns URL for dynamic A, AAAA and TXT records; no SDK and no documented REST API
chaining: reverse DNS and secondary zones, which the other free providers in this set do not do as readily

limits.value: the service is in open beta and is limited to IPv6 certification or tunnelbroker account holders, colocation customers and transit customers; no record count and no query cap is published

identity_cost.detail: one free registration shared by ipv6.he.net, tunnelbroker.net and dns.he.net, whose form requires an account name, a password, an e-mail address that receives the activation link, a first and last name, a country, a street address, a city, a state or region, a postal code and a phone number; no code check of the phone is stated and no card is asked; existing admin.he.net customers ask support for a password (https://tunnelbroker.net/register.php, https://dns.he.net/)

reliability_note: the registration form is withheld from some source networks, which receive 'Your IP address is not permitted to register at this time (This network is restricted)' in its place
confidence_note: the service page was read and states the eligibility gate and the dyndns syntax.

notes: An unpublished cap is a discretionary throttle. A design that depends on it has no ceiling to plan against, which is worse than a small published one. The interface field is 'unknown' rather than 'rest' because the only programmatic path is a key-based dyndns URL, which cannot create a zone or enumerate records.
